| External dependencies | None |
| Deployment values | Thresholds, counts, limits, partitions, retention and login secret reference are environment values; not specified in the source documents (GAP-2505). Five runbook entries reviewed with the on-call rota before promotion |

disposition.note: Story is already wave 2 under EP02. The booking confirmation build in wave 2 belongs to EP03 scope, not this deployment story. No edit.

disposition.change: Drop the account_payment_id CROSS_REF uuid (T3.1 DF-FIN-004, T3.3). Keep one varchar(255) business-key column paymentCode holding the ACE payment_code, with no foreign key.
disposition.note: Proceeds match key belongs in the TSD field list, not this story.

disposition.change: In A2.11.2, reconcile FEAT-PAY-11 to the ACE payment and account position and the posting file delivered. Add a ledger return and an open question only if the ledger owner publishes one.
disposition.note: Reconciliation scope is set in the FSD feature overview.

disposition.change: Keep one matching run per business date in wave 2. Record the payment-received same-day trigger as an open question. Add an intraday run only when an interface carrying payments intraday is named.
disposition.note: Matching run cadence is an FSD and application-story decision.

disposition.change: State the receipt-to-installment ratio observed on ACE data for a busy month in the next NFR version. Until then the volume test uses that ratio as an assumption.
disposition.note: Ratio value is not in the source documents; NFR version must carry it.

disposition.change: Keep rwb-decision placement. Split the record: rwb-payment writes the local record in its own transaction and publishes it; rwb-decision holds package, rows, test cases, collects records, appends to the ledger and runs JOB-14, and evaluates no payment.
disposition.note: Record split is set in the work package and the payment and decision contracts.

disposition.change: Fix one DecisionRecorded shape and one consumer group. Take decision codes from LOV-DECISION. Carry inputs_ref as an opaque reference. Keep the input age limit key as a placeholder read through DP-06. Publish the read page default with the read.
disposition.note: Contract shapes and codes belong to the contract story.

disposition.change: Publish v1 with the two operations, three event schemas, nine declarations, schema baseline and message map. Mark unsettled elements with the placeholder and one review row. Gate the tag on contract tests and schema lint.
disposition.note: Contract slice is owned by the CON story.
Added deployment-values row to header: environment values for thresholds, limits and login secret reference; runbook entries reviewed with on-call before promotion.

disposition.change: Build the plan position from TSD columns. Apply ProceedsMatched and PaymentMissed through the inbox. Name activities applyProceedsMatched and holdMissedInstallment. Serve the position in API-S2-002. Confirm package and frequency at contract freeze.
disposition.note: Treatment route and activity names belong to the application story.
